name: Nadir Kraken
oracle_text: Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and create a 1/1 blue Tentacle creature token.
blocked_sentences: Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and create a 1/1 blue Tentacle creature token.

needs.what: a token id for a 1/1 blue Tentacle creature token -- e.g. `tentacle_1_1_u`: types ["Creature"], subtypes ["Tentacle"], power 1, toughness 1, colors ["U"], color_identity ["U"], is_token true, no keywords and no abilities. Structurally identical to the shipped `fish_1_1_u` (1/1 blue Fish creature) with the subtype changed to Tentacle, so it is a one-line data addition with no engine work behind it. The same token is printed by every Nadir Kraken-style Tentacle maker, so the one id closes the family.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids is a closed list and contains no Tentacle entry at all. The nearest blue creature tokens are `fish_1_1_u` (1/1 blue Fish creature) -- right size, right color, wrong creature type -- `illusion_1_1_u_flying` (right size and color but a different type and it flies), `komas_coil_3_3_u` (3/3 blue Serpent) and `kraken_8_8_u` (8/8 blue Kraken), both the wrong size. Substituting `fish_1_1_u` would silently change the token's creature type for everything that reads types -- tribal anthems and lords, "creatures of the chosen type", changeling interactions, sacrifice-a-Fish and type-based removal -- and the brief forbids approximating a token. `create_token` takes only `token`, `amount`, `as`, `attacking`, `controller` and `tapped` in op_options, with no subtypes/colors/power/toughness override, so the printed Tentacle type cannot be spelled from the card. `add_subtype` after the fact would not fix it either: it would add Tentacle on top of Fish rather than create the printed token, and it would need the token bound and re-found after creation.

notes: The token is the ONLY thing blocking this card -- everything else is expressible today, and the card ships the moment the one-line token id lands. One ability, triggered, text "Whenever you draw a card, you may pay {1}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and create a 1/1 blue Tentacle creature token.", trigger {"event": "draw", "controller": "you"}, effects [{"op": "may", "player": "you", "prompt": "Pay {1} to grow Nadir Kraken and create a Tentacle?", "pay": {"mana": "{1}"}, "effects": [{"op": "add_counters", "counter": "+1/+1", "amount": {"const": 1}, "objects": {"self_only": true}}, {"op": "create_token", "token": "<the new tentacle_1_1_u id>", "amount": {"const": 1}}]}]. The "you may pay {1}. If you do, ..." clause is the proven `may` + `pay: {"mana": ...}` + `effects` shape that shipped `mystic_remora` already uses for its cumulative upkeep, and the +1/+1 counter on the source is the `add_counters` with `objects: {"self_only": true}` that shipped `high_society_hunter` uses -- neither needs anything new. Expectation would be {"zone": "battlefield", "battlefield_count": 33}: nothing in the sandbox position draws a card after the Kraken resolves, so the trigger never fires and neither `counters` nor `tokens` can be asserted -- only the creature arriving on the battlefield.
